_about: Dated vendor changes that move an AI bill without a code change. One list for the free close (website) and the ledger, copied byte for byte. A factor is the new price over what the customer pays today; a retirement prices the usual replacement. checked is the day every entry was last read at its source (memory/research/vendor-change-feed-2026-11-04.md).

changes.note: OpenAI replaced Priority processing with Fast mode, billed at twice the standard price, on 30 July.
Claude Opus 4.1 retired on 5 August. Opus 4.8 lists at $5 and $25 per million, against $15 and $75.
OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Sol to $4 and $20 per million on 21 August as a promotion.
Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 launched on 1 September with cache reads at $0.25 per million, 0.025 times input, against $1 on Fable 5.
Anthropic resumed billing three kinds of refusal on 24 September, after not billing refusals with no output since 2 June.
GPT-6.1 Sol launched on 29 September with cached input at $0.10 per million, half of GPT-6 Sol, and cache writes at $2.50 against $2 input.
Anthropic halved Sonnet 5.5 cache reads, from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens, on 7 October.
Bedrock halved Claude Sonnet 5.5 cache reads on 7 October.
Claude Opus 4.1 on Bedrock entered extended access on 8 October at a higher price set by Anthropic; it ends on 8 January.
Since 8 October Google sends gemini-3.5-flash calls to Gemini 3.6 Flash and bills them at its rates.
OpenAI added a 12-hour prompt cache on 20 October, with writes at 2.5 times the input price.
Microsoft Foundry retires Claude Haiku 4.5 on 15 November, with no replacement named.
Azure retires o1, o3, o3-mini and o4-mini on 19 November and moves Standard deployments to GPT-5.6 Sol or Terra.
Fast mode on Claude Opus 4.8 ends on 30 November and calls with it fail after. Opus 5.5 fast is $8 and $40 per million, against $10 and $50.
Claude Sonnet 4.5 retires on 30 November, and calls to it fail after. Sonnet 5.5 lists at $2 and $10 per million, against $3 and $15.
GPT-5.6 Sol promotional pricing of $4 and $20 per million runs until 30 November; the price after it is not yet published.
From 1 December Google sends gemini-2.5-flash calls to Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite at its rates: text prices are the same, audio input falls 70%.
From 1 December Google sends gemini-2.5-pro calls to Gemini 3.8 Flash and bills them at its rates: input 40% lower and output 62.5% lower in December.
Gemini 4 Argon doubles in price on 1 December.
OpenAI shuts down o3 on 11 December. GPT-5.6 Sol lists at $4 and $20 per million, against $2 and $8.
OpenAI shuts down gpt-5 on 11 December. GPT-5.6 Sol lists at $4 and $20 per million, against $1.25 and $10.
OpenAI shuts down gpt-5-mini on 11 December. GPT-5.6 Terra lists at $2 and $12 per million, against $0.25 and $2.
OpenAI shuts down gpt-5-nano on 11 December. GPT-5.6 Luna lists at $0.20 and $1.20 per million, against $0.05 and $0.40.
Rerouted gemini-2.5-pro calls follow Gemini 3.8 Flash, which doubles on 1 January: against gemini-2.5-pro, input 20% higher and output 25% lower.
Gemini 3.6 Flash doubles in price on 1 January.
Gemini 3.8 Flash doubles in price on 1 January.
Azure moves Standard gpt-4o 2024-05-13 deployments to gpt-5.1 on 14 January and bills them at its rates.
OpenAI shuts down GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 on 14 January. GPT-6 Luna lists at $0.10 and $0.50 per million, against $2.50 and $10 for GPT-4o.
